title: Controversy over pressure from Agriculture Minister Yana to increase budgets for municipalities that supported him
summary: Government investigates whether Minister Yana linked road fund allocation to electoral support, while opposition demands his resignation.

title: British novelist Jeffrey Archer, author of 'Kane and Abel', dies at 86
summary: His works sold over 300 million copies and he was also a Conservative politician and philanthropist.

title: Dewi Fujin fined 200,000 yen for assault on former managers
summary: The Indonesian celebrity received a guilty verdict for two cases of violence against her former managers.

title: Suzuki launches 'e Sky', Japan's cheapest light electric car at 2.12 million yen
summary: The model, going on sale in November, uses BYD batteries and cuts equipment to achieve the segment's lowest price.

title: Japan protests to US after arrest of Marine for murder in Okinawa
summary: The incident occurs at a politically delicate moment and rekindles tension over US military presence in the prefecture.

title: Data breach of 1.73 million customers of discount chain MrMax
summary: Members' personal information, including names and addresses, was exposed in a security incident.

title: Government installs barriers at most dangerous underpasses and classifies flood risk into four levels
summary: Following torrential rains, the Ministry of Land orders preventive traffic regulations and automatic closure systems.

title: Nikkei tops 70,000 points for first time in three months driven by US tech stocks
summary: The index rises 134 yen at the open and holds the psychological level thanks to optimism over corporate earnings.

title: 10-year bond yield reaches 3.1%, level not seen in 30 years, pressuring public finances
summary: The rise in long-term rates reflects global structural changes and raises the cost of Japanese sovereign debt.

title: Kyoto unveils 250 restored costumes for Festival of the Ages, including those of Ono no Komachi and Toyotomi Hideyoshi
summary: The historical procession, one of the city's three major festivals, will be held on October 22 with renewed attire.

title: Nepal ends search for 5,200 missing in avalanche, including 5 Japanese
summary: Authorities conclude survival is impossible after weeks of fruitless efforts in the remote area.
